ops.text: Since I met you, I've not been myself.
With you, I've become a better person.
{color=#ffffff}'You can start by filling in these forms.'{/color}
{color=#ffffff}He was strict on himself and others.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}I respected him for his hard work.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}'From now on, stay by my side.'{/color}
{color=#ffffff}I want to be by your side.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}'I told you, I need you by my side.'{/color}
{color=#ffffff}A few months later, when I had recovered enough...{/color}
Sorry, I'm late! What do you need me to do?
I need you to fill in these employment forms.
(These must be the new employment terms. I'd better take a good look before I sign.)
I want to make this official.
You have a problem with that?
What if I want to negotiate?
You didn't have to go to all this trouble.
I'll be your girlfriend, no conditions needed.
I didn't know how to put it in words...
You'll stay here with me from now on?
I can't believe he asked me to be his girlfriend.
I'm so happy, I feel like I'm dreaming right now!
What if it's all just a dream?
You helped me to be a better person.

ops.text: You were brave to tell me your thoughts.
It's my turn to be brave for you.

ops.text: {color=#ffffff}'Maachan! Don't run off on your own!'{/color}
{color=#ffffff}That day, I helped Kirako bring her cat to see Shiro as usual, but.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}A few months later, when I had recovered enough...{/color}
I've been waiting for you, Naomi.
Sorry, I'm late! Where are the patient notes?
I have something to tell you.
I've decided that I don't want to be your doctor.
(Wait, what? Did I do something wrong?)
I want to be your boyfriend instead.
What I mean is, yes! I'll be your girlfriend.
Now you made me feel shy too.
Will you stay here with me from now on?
I can't believe he asked me out.
I'm so happy, I feel like I'm dreaming right now!
What if it's all just a dream?
You helped me to be true to myself.
It's my turn to help you remember who you are.

ops.text: {color=#ffffff}A classmate who seemed aloof, until one day.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}'That really means a lot to me.'{/color}
{color=#ffffff}He was often shy to say how he felt, but.{/color}
{color=#ffffff}I was happy when he told me that.{/color}

I've been waiting for you, Naomi.
There's something I need to tell you.
Will you stay here with me from now on?
